pattern: If a component labeled (1), or a component id ending in _1, has values only at VU levels 92/96/100, the parser probably attached a VU addition to the primary base effect.
resolution: Add review reason primary_labeled_effect_vu_only_needs_review and show it in the HTML suspicious section. Treat it as a parser alignment failure by default unless the detail page explicitly says the main (1) effect is VU-only.

pattern: Large ingestion batches need repeated run -> agent review -> parser fix -> rerun -> agent review -> manual final review cycles, and this state must be recoverable by another AI.
resolution: Add review_cycle_controller.py to run/summarize a batch, write data/agent_runs/<batch>_cycle_state.json, and generate a bounded Batch Review Expert prompt from report/JSONL paths and blocking items.

pattern: Some skill tables put independent values in headers such as (1)効果 (自身) and (2)(3)効果 (編成内), leaving the plain 効果 column empty.
resolution: Build row_fact.effect from every header containing 効果 except duration/time columns, so labeled value extraction sees all effect columns.

pattern: ATK/DEF values can be formulas such as ATK +0.18×移動距離(km)% rather than plain numeric percentages.
resolution: Parse formula percentages before plain stat percentages and store value_unit=formula_percent with raw formula text; do not truncate the decimal as a normal number.

pattern: A single effect row can grant both 軽減不能なダメージ/固定ダメージ and 相手に経験値.
resolution: Split into fixed_damage and exp_gain components; when 相手 is present, set target_scope to opponent_denko. Treat 軽減不能なダメージ as fixed_damage for mismatch checks.

pattern: Supplemental effects may say a previous labeled effect fires again, such as (3)リンクしたとき(2)経験値付与がもう1回発動.
resolution: When a supplemental component references an earlier label of the same effect_kind and has no explicit new target phrase, inherit target_scope and target_filters from the referenced component.

pattern: Some useful effects are not plain ATK/DEF/EXP percentages, such as レーダー最大検知数+2 or これまでアクセスしたことのある駅へのランダムアクセス.
resolution: Create radar_detection_range and random_previous_station_access components instead of leaving rows without components.

pattern: A few pages still have high-risk semantic ambiguity after rule parsing.
resolution: Keep them in review_queue/report instead of force-filling: link continuation/transfer, VU-only duration/disable combinations, score increase-or-decrease branches, and complex labeled eco/attribute branches should go to manual or LLM snippet review.

pattern: Effect labels can live in table headers such as 効果(1), 効果(2), 効果(3), while each cell value has no explicit label.
resolution: Prefix a single label from the effect header into the cell text before component extraction; exclude non-value headers such as 効果時間 and 効果範囲.

pattern: Damage reduction can appear as ダメージ -1.2×n or labeled fixed values in compound columns such as (2)(3)効果.
resolution: Parse labeled ダメージ values into damage_reduction or fixed_damage components, storing formula_flat_damage when the value depends on n.

pattern: A row comment can mention 編成内 for a later labeled effect, contaminating the target of an earlier label if the full comment is used.
resolution: Use the relevant source segment for enrichment; when no explicit target is present, damage_reduction defaults to self.

pattern: Phrases such as 自分以外, 自身以外, and 自身を除く describe effect recipients, not just conditions.
resolution: For buff/exp/score/damage_reduction components, infer target_scope=team_all and target_filters.exclude_self=true when those phrases appear in the label-specific condition.

pattern: Some effect summaries use fullwidth labels （2） while probability cells use halfwidth labels (2), so probability boost extraction missed VU-only activation probability additions.
resolution: Normalize label brackets before checking for (2) and build activation_probability_boost from labeled probability cells only when 発動率増加/上昇 is the effect.

pattern: A single effect cell can contain multiple labeled percentages such as (1)16% (2)4.5%.
resolution: Split multiple labeled percent values and infer the effect kind from the matching labeled condition segment.

pattern: Skill disable effects sometimes have no numeric value column and only appear in the labeled condition text.
resolution: Allow condition-only skill_disable components, and drop unlabeled duplicate condition components when a labeled component of the same effect kind exists.

pattern: Remarks can declare a label as Lv92+ only, for example (2)はLv.92以降で発動, while parser values may accidentally cover pre-VU levels.
resolution: Add vu_label_level_mismatch_needs_review as a blocking health reason instead of silently treating the component as parsed.

pattern: VU additions can be written as (2) (1)+30, meaning a delta on the primary fixed damage value.
resolution: Parse labeled (1)+N deltas as additional_fixed_damage when the labeled condition segment is about fixed damage.

expected_components.note_zh: Branch should distinguish opponent cool/heat conditions; exact mapping needs snippet/manual confirmation.
No-reboot outcome grants experience and score; should not be DEF debuff.

issue_summary_zh: Raw condition has merged-cell style displaced attributes: '(1)相手が ならDEF+15%、 ならDEF-10% cool属性 heat属性'. The attributes appear after the sentence and should fill the earlier blanks as opponent-side conditions. Component (2) says '被アクセス時、リブートしなかったら経験値とスコア獲得', but parser produced def_debuff_2, which contradicts the Japanese effect text.
parser_failure_zh: Postfixed attribute tokens were treated as generic attributes, and value/effect mapping reused DEF text for a label whose condition describes EXP/score. This is a semantic consistency failure, not merely a missing numeric value.
suggested_rule_zh: Validation agent must compare condition_raw effect words against effect_kind and detect trailing attribute placeholders after merged-cell expansion. Parser should flag or split attribute-branch effects instead of force-mapping them to a single own-team attribute filter.

pattern: Components whose values exist only at Lv92/Lv96/Lv100 are valid VU-only additions.
resolution: Do not flag blank Lv30/Lv50 for component-level values when all parsed values are VU levels.

pattern: A labeled condition can represent skill continuation without a numeric effect cell.
resolution: Create a condition-only component with effect_kind skill_continue and attach per-level probability values from the matching probability label.

pattern: One value expression may apply to both ATK and DEF, or unlabeled same-stat values may need condition-order mapping.
resolution: Split shared ATK/DEF values into separate components and use condition labels/order to assign repeated values.

pattern: Effect text can place labels after effect names or group multiple labeled numeric values under one effect kind.
resolution: Parse label-value pairs even when the label does not precede the effect keyword directly.

pattern: Skill-level rows may say 下記参照 while a nearby subtable contains authoritative seasonal values.
resolution: Merge the seasonal subtable into per-level component values; keep explicit seasonal target_scope so later text enrichment cannot overwrite it.

pattern: VU-only components should not look blank in reports and should be explicit in JSON.
resolution: Add component.availability.levels and component.availability.vu_only; HTML report renders missing Lv30/Lv50 on VU-only components as ※VU生效.

pattern: Many conditions mention formation/opponent restrictions, not the buff target itself.
resolution: Distinguish target_scope from target_filters: name_contains_any, opponent_attribute, opponent_team_attribute_min_count, own_team_attribute_min_count, own_team_all_attribute, opponent_team_all_attribute, formation_size_min, exclude_self, and relative_position.

pattern: 曜日に応じた skills can have no numeric effect in the main row but still represent multiple independent effect branches.
resolution: Create weekday_variable components for Sunday through Saturday branches and VU-only daytime/nighttime components when Lv92+ rows contain 昼/夜 additions.

pattern: Some complex rows parse into components but the semantic mapping is visibly wrong.
resolution: Flag attribute branch effects and condition/effect mismatches as high-priority report suspicious items instead of force-filling uncertain values.

pattern: Duration extension values may appear as バッテリー1個につき+X分 without the 効果時間 prefix.
resolution: Parse battery-based duration delta values into duration_extension components and add trigger_conditions.event_hint=battery_use.

issue_summary_zh: (1)DEF増加 / (2)発動回数に応じて追加でDEF増加 should be two components, but parser treated probability text as content and split into three components.
parser_failure_zh: Probability values with labels were parsed as value/content; percent sign may have been lost. Check fullwidth/halfwidth or mixed parentheses/percent handling.
suggested_rule_zh: Normalize fullwidth/halfwidth parentheses and percent signs before parsing; labeled probability columns belong to probability, not value_raw. Do not create activation_probability_boost unless probability itself is the effect.

issue_summary_zh: Lv30 parsed but Lv50 missing, which should be an automatic parse error/review trigger.
parser_failure_zh: Component values are incomplete at key practical level Lv50.
suggested_rule_zh: If any component has Lv30 but lacks Lv50 while the skill table has Lv50, add review_reason=key_level_component_missing and classify needs_parser_rule.

issue_summary_zh: Line break before condition 'coolとecoのみ編成' caused parsing drift. Expected (1) fixed damage and (2) damage reduction; both conditioned on cool/eco-only formation.
parser_failure_zh: Condition text split by line break was not attached to both labeled effects.
suggested_rule_zh: Normalize line breaks in condition/effect cells and support multi-attribute filters, e.g. attributes=[cool, eco] with formation_only=true.

issue_summary_zh: Actual semantics are three effects: DEF増加 / ATK減少 / 固定軽減. Parser generally found the right idea but scattered them into four slots.
parser_failure_zh: Component split over-fragmented a multi-effect description.
suggested_rule_zh: Support negative ATK/DEF as debuff kinds and merge duplicate fragments by condition label and effect_kind.

issue_summary_zh: Parser output collapsed or misread labeled effects; needs recheck after labeled probability/value separation.
parser_failure_zh: Labeled components and probabilities appear mis-assigned.
suggested_rule_zh: Re-run after #125-style labeled probability normalization; if still ambiguous, add snippet/manual review.

issue_summary_zh: Special case where (1)(2) are combined together. If not easily generalized, flag for manual handling rather than forcing parser guesses.
parser_failure_zh: Compound label syntax such as '(1)(2)' is ambiguous for component splitting.

issue_summary_zh: Skill has different trigger direction: active access by own team and accessed event on station currently held by self. This should be an explicit trigger dimension.
parser_failure_zh: Access direction/ownership condition is not represented enough for solver usage.
suggested_rule_zh: Extend trigger_conditions with access_direction/accessed_direction and station_ownership context, e.g. access_event=own_access or own_link_accessed.

issue_summary_zh: Parser recognized labels but only emitted one component, which is clearly incomplete.
parser_failure_zh: Labeled effect count and emitted component count mismatch.
suggested_rule_zh: If labeled condition/effect rows contain multiple labels but parsed component count is lower, add review_reason=labeled_component_count_mismatch.

issue_summary_zh: Lv30/Lv50 blanks indicate parser failure and should trigger review automatically.
parser_failure_zh: Key practical levels missing from component values.
suggested_rule_zh: Treat blank Lv30 or Lv50 cells in the report as a parser health check failure when the source skill table has those rows.

issue_summary_zh: Parsed (2) but only filled one skill component; expected multiple labeled components.
parser_failure_zh: Label detection did not correspond to component emission.
suggested_rule_zh: Add labeled_component_count_mismatch check and keep record in needs_parser_rule until components match labels.

result_summary_zh: Removed false activation_probability_boost. Parsed two DEF components: def_buff_1 probability 75%, def_buff_2 probability 100% with scaling basis activation_count.
Lv50 value now parses. Negative ATK is represented as atk_debuff.
Parsed fixed_damage_1 and damage_reduction_2. Preserved cool/eco-only formation filters and active/accessed trigger direction.
Parsed three components: def_buff_1, atk_debuff_2, damage_reduction_3. Each labeled probability resolves to 70%.
False activation_probability_boost is gone, but labeled_component_count_mismatch remains. Needs parser rule or manual snippet for effect (2) duration extension.
False activation_probability_boost is gone and (1)/(2) ATK components parse, but (3) reboot/probability effect remains intentionally unresolved; keep manual/special parser case.
Link trigger now records event_hint=link and access_direction=own_team_link. Additional station ownership/accessed nuance still needs schema/parser refinement if source distinguishes it.
Still only def_buff_1 is emitted. labeled_component_count_mismatch and compound_labeled_effect_needs_manual_review remain, as intended for follow-up.
Lv30 and Lv50 range values now parse, including decimal/range handling.
Fullwidth labels parse. Emits def_buff_1 with linked_denko_count scaling and def_buff_2 with self_linking station ownership condition.
Component order now follows labels. Raw condition is split into fixed_damage_1 and damage_reduction_2, both retaining cool/eco-only formation condition and active/accessed direction.
Special format with 発動条件 + 効果(1)/(2)/(3) now splits into def_buff_1, atk_debuff_2, damage_reduction_3. Internal references like (1)発動時 no longer split labels.
Effect (1) ATK buff and effect (2) duration_extension are split. duration_extension is condition-only and remains marked condition_only_component_needs_review.
Component order now shows fixed_damage_1 before additional_fixed_damage_2.
Still unusual. Parser emits def_buff_1 and condition-only battery_disable_3, but recovery effect (2) remains unresolved and record stays suspicious/manual.
Label mismatch remains visible. Additional EXP effect is not filled because value semantics are not safely separated yet.
Effect (1) ATK and condition-only reboot_2 split correctly; probabilities are separated into 100% and 15%. Reboot remains condition-only review.
Label mismatch remains visible. Weather-based secondary EXP effect still needs a dedicated parser or manual snippet.
Duplicate labeled DEF values are now flagged with duplicate_labeled_component_values_need_review.
Label mismatch remains visible for the AP/maxHP-difference additional fixed damage condition.
Parsing still works as before but remains suspicious because score components are not safely mapped to labels in this compound (2)(1) description.
効果時間延長已从效果列解析为 duration_extension_2，并保留 Lv30/Lv50/Lv60/Lv70/Lv80 的延长时间与(2)60%概率。
已拆成 def_buff_1、hp_recovery_2、battery_disable_3；(2)(3)备注不再误判为编号错位。battery_disable 是二值副作用，保留 condition_only_component_needs_review 但不进入顶部可疑项。
経験値付与已支持同一效果列多 match，解析出 exp_gain_1 与 exp_gain_2，Lv30/Lv50 均完整。
経験値付与已支持同一效果列多 match，解析出按今日访问站数变化的 exp_gain_1 与阴天天气条件的 exp_gain_2。
同数值的 def_buff_1/def_buff_2 因原文注明(1)と(2)は重複発動可，判定为合法叠加条件，不再作为重复错位告警。
固定ダメージ已支持同一效果列多 match，解析出基础 fixed_damage_1 与 AP<最大HP 差值条件 fixed_damage_2。
効果時間 バッテリー1個につき+n分 已解析为 duration_extension_3，保留各等级延长值。
スコア獲得已携带(1)/(2)标签，解析出 score_gain_1 与 additional_score_gain_2；(2)(1)発動後 是引用前一效果，不再误判为编号错位。
详情说明中(1)为アクセスしたでんこに経験値を与えるため target_scope 修正为 accessing_denko；(2)仍为編成内のでんこに経験値付与，target_scope 为 team_all。同批次扫描未发现アクセスしたでんこに却仍标为team_all的残留。
合并单元格导致的属性占位文本 と の両属性のでんこのみ編成 cool eco 已清理为 coolとecoの両属性のでんこのみ編成；结构化 target_filters 原本已正确保留 attributes=[cool, eco] 与 formation_only=true。
